name: green_day2_20261101
directive: PI 2026-11-01: through about tomorrow use all four pod GPUs to discover new uses of green (cell-centre annotations / detectors). Parent starting points: CD headroom; framed images (black_frac > 0.01, 48% of rows) are recipe A's weak spot; detector density per tissue area / Voronoi area restricted to tissue; ROI-sized 538x408 windows; hex6 half as effective on framed images.
base: hybrid B (experiments/recipeA_analysis_20261028/hybrid_oof.npz, B_hybrid_w0p5; 8.8772 on 8954 rows); the 20 leaked train-green rows excluded from every number; official metric via experiments/eval_harness_20261031/source/eval_oof_20261031.py; donor-cluster paired bootstrap for CIs.
fold_discipline: all features fold-clean (OOF detectors); LOFO calibration a+b log f and blend weight w chosen on the fitting folds only; development = folds 0-3 (pooled delta), confirmation = fold 4 reported separately; stratified variants choose w per stratum (framed: black_frac > 0.01 / unframed) on the fitting folds.

D1_cd_fullframe_density.question: Can CD from a full-frame detector (pre-trained-only sg2pre seeds 46/47/48, never fine-tuned on CLEAR-EC) correct B's CD, especially on framed images?
features: vor_cd: 1/median bounded Voronoi cell area of interior cells (>= 15 px from black or border, area <= 3x median)
nn_cd: hexagonal-lattice density from median nearest-neighbour spacing of interior peaks

win_*_cd: peaks in a 538x408 window / 0.1307 mm^2 for the max-mean-score window (quality), the densest window, the median-density window (typical) and the window centred on the compact fine-tuned detector's cluster (cluster)
family mean = mean log over the three pre-only seeds
D1_cd_fullframe_density.gate: stratified LOFO blend into B's CD: overall delta <= -0.03 pp mean (CD <= -0.09 pp) with >= 4/5 folds improving AND framed-stratum delta <= -0.05 pp mean, OR framed-stratum delta <= -0.08 pp mean with the unframed stratum not worse than +0.01; fold-4 delta must be negative; error correlation with B's CD error reported (mechanism).
D1_cd_fullframe_density.stop_rule: if no feature reaches |delta| >= 0.01 pp mean on folds 0-3, the CD route from existing pre-only peaks is closed; GPU detector work then targets recall (TTA, frame augmentation) only if the best feature's fold-wise w > 0.

D2_hex6_tissue_variants.question: Does restricting hex6 to tissue-interior cells (or to the cluster window) recover the lost half of the gain on framed images?
features: hex6_all (three pre-only seeds, standard) as the control
D2_hex6_tissue_variants.gate: LOFO on B's HEX: beats the three-pre-family control by >= 0.005 pp mean overall AND by >= 0.005 on the framed stratum; fold-4 negative; a passing variant is then re-evaluated inside the ten-family active composition before any deployment talk.

G1_preonly_tta.what: four-flip TTA peaks of the three pre-only detectors, fold-clean (lane01, GPUs 0-1)
G1_preonly_tta.gate: adopted for D1/D2 if it improves the best D1 or D2 feature's stratified delta by >= 0.005 pp mean

G2_pretrain_frame_aug.what: srep pre-training with synthetic black frames / vignettes / blur / contrast jitter (negatives in blacked-out regions), 2000 updates per fold, seed 46, then TTA peaks (lane23, GPUs 2-3)
G2_pretrain_frame_aug.gate: same as G1; additionally its peaks-per-image on framed images must not drop below 80% of the unframed median (coverage check)

D1b_quality_gated_cd.what: blend weight per tercile/quintile of label-free detector-quality covariates (inter-seed agreement, interior count, window score, framed x agreement)

D2b_active_hex6_coverage_gate.what: coverage-conditional blend weight for the ACTIVE ten-family hex6 (strata = terciles of summed detection count / pre-only count / inter-family spread / framed)
D2b_active_hex6_coverage_gate.gate: >= 0.005 pp mean over the plain ten-family LOFO (about -0.0311), fold-4 delta negative, >= 4/5 folds improving

G3_hex6_auxiliary_finetune.what: multi-task fine-tune of the recipe A seed-46 fold checkpoints for 2 epochs (encoder lr 3e-6, head 3e-4, batch 16) with an auxiliary linear head on the 128-d hidden predicting the fold-clean active ten-family mean-log hex6 (lambda 1) vs an identical control fine-tune with lambda 0; TTA4 predictions of CD/CV/HEX and of the distilled hex6 on the held fold; folds 0-1 on lane23, 2-4 on lane01

gates.G3a_representation: aux arm beats the control arm on HEX MAPE (LOFO-scalar calibrated, single seed) by >= 0.10 pp on folds 0-3 pooled and fold 4 also improves
gates.G3b_submission: with the s46 member of B replaced by the aux arm (LOFO scalars re-fit), B_new + re-fit hex6 blend beats B + active hex6 (8.8772 - 0.0311) by >= 0.03 pp mean with >= 4/5 folds improving
gates.G3c_distilled_hex6: the aux head's hex6 prediction alone, LOFO log-blended into B's HEX, reaches <= -0.02 pp mean (deployment-cost alternative to the ten detectors)

G3_hex6_auxiliary_finetune.controls: control arm isolates the effect of extra training from the auxiliary objective; the 20 train-green rows are excluded from the aux loss and from every score

D2c_new_members_in_active_hex6.what: each new full-frame detector family (frame-aug aug_s46; TTA s46/s47/s48) as a member of the ACTIVE ten-family hex6: swap for sg2pre_s46, add as eleventh, add all; hex6 with the deployed definition; LOFO on B
D2c_new_members_in_active_hex6.gate: >= 0.005 pp mean better than the control ten (about -0.0311), fold-4 delta negative, >= 4/5 folds improving

D2d_tissue_filtered_hex6.what: deployed-definition hex6 computed on peaks restricted to the non-black tissue mask, for the full-frame members sg2pre_s46 (shipped) and aug_s46; compositions: ten with filtered pre; ten + filtered aug; singles
D2d_tissue_filtered_hex6.gate: >= 0.005 pp mean over the control ten, fold-4 negative, >= 4/5 folds; evidence-only under the adoption rule

G3d_lambda3_dose_response.what: G3 aux arm with lambda 3 (same schedule, seed, data), folds 0-4 on lane23 (GPUs 2-3); dose-response check of the auxiliary objective
G3d_lambda3_dose_response.gate: same as G3a against the control arm; adopted as the G3 arm only if it beats lambda 1 on folds 0-3 pooled HEX by >= 0.05 pp and fold 4 agrees

deployment_condition: a passing finding joins submission 2 only if it passes its gate on top of B + the active hex6 and runs in the T4 container (fp16, efficient/math SDPA) in < ~100 s per case.
reporting: status to the parent every ~3 h; ranked summary at the end; every run in experiments/green_track_20261028/ledger.json.
